title: Canadian Steak Kebabs
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish that combines the richness of steak with the freshness of herbal spices.

ingredients.name: 1.5 lbs Steak ( ribeye or strip loin )

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, herbal spice blend, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Thread steak, pineapple, and Canadian bacon onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with the olive oil mixture, making sure all the ingredients are coated.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the steak reaches an internal temperature of 135°F for medium-rare.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as grilled vegetables or a salad.
